purpose: Form RSC-4 is used by the Tribunal to give directions for notice publication to seek objections from creditors and intimate about the date of hearing for the reduction of share capital.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within seven days from the date on which directions are given by the Tribunal.
steps: Receive directions from the Tribunal for the notice to be published.
Publish the notice in Form No. RSC-4 within seven days from the date of directions.
Publish the notice in an English language in a leading English newspaper and in a leading vernacular language newspaper in the State where the registered office is situated.
Upload the notice on the website of the company if the company has a website.
Wait for objections to be filed in the Tribunal within three months from the date of publication.
checklist: Ensure Form No. RSC-4 notice content states the amount of the proposed reduction of share capital.
Ensure the notice states the places where the list of creditors may be inspected.
Ensure the notice states the time fixed by the Tribunal within which creditors may send objections.
Verify newspapers chosen are leading newspapers with wide circulation in the State where the registered office is situated.
watch: Objections must be filed in the Tribunal within three months from the date of publication of the notice with a copy served on the company.
